title: Portable USB Electric Juicer – 6-Blade Blender & Shaker | Chef’s Embrace
body_html:
Craving fresh, healthy drinks on the go? Our Portable pink personal blender with strap from Chef’s Embrace is your perfect companion! This innovative device combines a powerful blender with a convenient drinking bottle, allowing you to whip up delicious smoothies, juices, and protein shakes anywhere, anytime. Designed for ultimate portability and ease of use, it’s ideal for busy professionals, fitness enthusiasts, and anyone who loves fresh beverages without the fuss. Say goodbye to bulky blenders and hello to effortless nutrition.

Experience the freedom of blending your favorite fruits and veggies wherever your day takes you. The robust 6-blade design ensures smooth, consistent results, easily crushing ice and tougher ingredients. With its rechargeable battery, this versatile device is more than just a juicer; it’s also a fantastic protein shaker and smoothie maker. Enjoy the taste of homemade goodness at work, at the gym, or while travelling across India. The 380ml capacity is perfect for a single serving, keeping your drinks fresh and ready to enjoy.

Key features

  • Powerful 6-Blade Design: Efficiently blends fruits, vegetables, and crushes ice for smooth results.
  • USB Rechargeable: Conveniently charges via any USB port, perfect for on-the-go use.
  • 380ml Capacity: Ideal single-serving size for fresh juices, smoothies, and protein shakes.
  • Multi-purpose Functionality: Works as a juicer, blender, and protein shaker cup.
  • Food-Grade Materials: Constructed from BPA-free food-grade PP & ABS plastic with 304 stainless steel blades for safety and durability.
  • Easy to Clean: Self-cleaning function with just water and a drop of detergent.
  • Portable & Lightweight: Detachable motor for easy carrying and storage, making it travel-friendly.

Materials & care

Crafted from high-quality, food-grade materials for your peace of mind. The body is made of BPA-free PP & ABS plastic, ensuring safety for all your beverages. The durable 6-blade assembly is fashioned from 304 stainless steel, known for its rust resistance and sharp blending performance.

Care Instructions:

  • After each use, add a little water and detergent to the cup and press the button for a quick self-clean cycle.
  • For a deeper clean, detach the motor base and wash the cup and lid with warm soapy water.
  • Do not immerse the motor base in water. Wipe it clean with a damp cloth.
  • Ensure all parts are completely dry before reassembling or storing.

FAQ

Q1: How long does it take to fully charge the Portable USB Electric Juicer?
A: Typically, it takes about 2-3 hours for a full charge. A full charge provides enough power for multiple blending cycles.
Q2: What kind of fruits can I blend with this juicer?
A: You can blend a wide variety of soft to medium-hard fruits like bananas, berries, mangoes, apples (cut into small pieces), and leafy greens. For best results, ensure fruits are cut into 1.5cm pieces and add sufficient liquid.
Q3: Is it safe to crush ice in this blender?
A: Yes, the powerful 6-blade design is capable of crushing small ice cubes. For optimal performance, add some liquid along with the ice.
Q4: Can I use it to make hot beverages?
A: This Portable USB Electric Juicer is designed for cold or room-temperature beverages only. Do not use it with hot liquids as it may damage the product and pose a safety risk.
Q5: Is the product covered by a warranty?
A: Please refer to our website's warranty policy or contact customer support for detailed information regarding product warranty.
